name: glideslope-monorepo
description: Glideslope design system: a Vue 3 + Reka UI design system with a Tailwind v4 foundation.

scripts.storybook: pnpm --filter "@wingbrace/glideslope^..." run build && pnpm --filter @wingbrace/glideslope run storybook
scripts.playground: pnpm --filter "playground^..." run build && pnpm --filter playground run dev
scripts.verify: pnpm build && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm lint && pnpm format:check
